summary: Generates up to four uniform floats into caller-supplied output pointers a3..a6. A seeding/validation call sub_559D80 gates the body; on success it reads a seed value from this[0x30C], increments it, and for each non-null output pointer invokes sub_58B077 with an advancing seed state to produce a float. Returns 1 when generation ran, 0 when the guard failed.

operations.description: Call sub_559D80(this, a2): PRNG seeding or state validation that gates the generation path; a non-zero result opens the body.
Guard on sub_559D80 returning non-zero; otherwise skip generation and return 0.
Read the seed at this[0x30C] and increment it by one; seed the advancing PRNG state a2 = seed + 1.
Set the success flag v7 = 1 once generation begins.
If output pointer a3 is non-null, fill it with the next uniform float.
*a3 = sub_58B077(seed, &a2): generate the first uniform float and advance the seed state a2.
Advance the seed state for the next draw: v10 = a2 + 1.
If output pointer a4 is non-null, fill it with the next uniform float.
*a4 = sub_58B077(seed, &a2): generate the second uniform float and advance the seed state.
Advance the seed state for the next draw: v10 = a2 + 1.
If output pointer a5 is non-null, fill it with the next uniform float.
*a5 = sub_58B077(seed, &a2): generate the third uniform float and advance the seed state.
Advance the seed state for the next draw: v10 = a2 + 1.
If output pointer a6 is non-null, fill it with the final uniform float.
*a6 = sub_58B077(seed, &a2): generate the fourth uniform float (no further seed advance).
Return v7: 1 when generation ran, 0 when the seeding guard failed.
